messages:
deploybot: :package: Release tag created: v1.12.3 (tag: v1.12.3)
deploybot: commit: `a7f4b9d` · branch: `main` · envs: staging -> canary -> prod
deploybot: changelog (summary):
  - fix: reduce kv-cache memory leak on long chats
  - perf: kernel switch for short sequences (20-64 tokens)
  - ops: add region-aware routing fallback

matt: nice, thanks. what's the planned canary window?
anya: pinging qa for quick smoke, will need ~30m once canary starts
kevin: can we pin dedicated customers on v1.12.2 for the next 2 hours? some contracts require no sudden model swaps
julia: @kevin yes let's do a soft-pin. ops team — can you apply pinning until we confirm no regressions?
kevin: putting request to release-control: `pin --customers=dedicated --version=v1.12.2 --ttl=2h`
sre-bot: Notice: EU region scheduled maintenance in 45m. Recommend holding prod rollout in eu-west-1 until after maintenance window.
matt: thanks @sre-bot — can we proceed with global canary but block eu-west-1?
deploybot: canary plan:
  - start: 2105012400
  - traffic: 1% -> 5% after 10m -> 20% after 30m (if OK)
  - regions: all except eu-west-1 (blocked)
  - health checks: latency p95, error-rate, model-quality checks (prompt set)

anya: QA will run smoke suite at +5m and +35m. I will post results here.
julia: ops, please prepare rollback playbook just in case (steps + who-to-pager).
kevin: rollback playbook linked: https://intranet.redwood/release-playbooks/v1.12.3-rollback (quick steps, will pager on severity >= 1)

matt: small request — there's a minor prompt-behavior change. Flagging for product: ensure internal prompt templates are updated.
julia: noted, creating doc update ticket.

deploybot: canary started at 2105012400 — deploying canary containers to allowed regions
anya: smoke +5m: all checks green except one reranking test flaky (0.5% failure)
matt: that's within expected range for the fix, but let's watch it.
anya: smoke +35m: green across the board. latency p95 improved slightly.
kevin: pin remains active for dedicated customers until 2125012345 per request.

deploybot: canary 20% traffic reached at 2105012520 — health OK, no error spikes
julia: recommend proceeding to staged prod rollout after 15m unless any objections
matt: thumbs up from eng-release :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Alert: autoscaler triggered additional nodes in us-central-1 during canary, CPU spiked to 78% but recovered. No action required.

anya: QA final run (post-canary) passed. I sign off for prod rollout in non-blocked regions.
kevin: removing soft-pin for europe-excluded customers; dedicated customers remain pinned until manual unpin.

deploybot: starting prod rollout (non-blocked regions) at 2105012600 — rolling by shard, expected completion ~30m

matt: monitoring logs and eval metrics. if model-quality drift > 0.8% on eval set, we roll back automatically.

sre-bot: Automation check: model-quality monitoring hook active. Threshold set to 0.8% regressions.

deploybot: prod rollout finished at 2105012650 in allowed regions. eu-west-1 still blocked.
matt: quick note — we saw one short spike in latency during shard 4, but it auto-resolved. No rollback needed.
julia: great work. I'll draft the release note snippet for the customer-facing changelog.
anya: QA will follow up tomorrow with an extended regression run.
kevin: will schedule unpin for dedicated customers after extended regression confirms stability (TBD).

deploybot: thread closed by deploybot. Release v1.12.3 tagged and rolled out to prod (partial regions)
